title: Settings for the software factory
description: The settings file, .claude/factory.yaml. An editor's help: `factory config check` is the check that counts.

version.description: The shape of this file, not the factory's version. Must be 2.

repository.description: The repository's owner and name, as owner/name.

presets.description: The presets this repository follows, each an npm package, or a folder of one, holding a factory-preset.yaml. Later ones win over earlier ones, and this file wins over them all.

tickets.description: Where tickets live and how their state is shown.

code-host.description: Where pull requests are, and what a build names its branch.

specs.description: How the written spec for a visible change is kept: openspec or none as one word, or a block with a type and the command that checks the specs.

tickets.description: Where tickets live and how their state is shown.

board.description: The number at the end of your GitHub Project's address, or none. Default: none.

tickets.labels.description: Your own names for the labels the factory puts on tickets. A key left out keeps its default name.

spec.description: The label on a change your users will see, which refinement writes a Spec into. Default: spec.

follow-up.description: The label on the one follow-ups ticket. Default: follow-up.

factory.description: The label on every ticket the factory works on: it acts on no other. Default: factory.

tickets.columns.description: Which of your board's columns shows each state. Needs a board. With a board, all six states are required, here or from a preset.

backlog.description: The board's column for the backlog state, or a list of its columns.

refining.description: The board's column for the refining state, or a list of its columns. May be none.

ready.description: The board's column for the ready state. May be none.

building.description: The board's column for the building state, or a list of its columns. May be none.

review.description: The board's column for the review state, or a list of its columns. May be none.

done.description: The board's column for the done state, or a list of its columns. May be none.

tickets.fields.description: Which of your fields holds each of the factory's fields: on the board, session, runs-in, and cost, which need a board; on the ticket, decisions, spec, acceptance-criteria, for-the-builder, and any heading of your own.

session.description: The board's field the sync writes for session. Default: Session. May be none.

runs-in.description: The board's field the sync writes for runs-in. Default: Runs in. May be none.

cost.description: The board's field the sync writes for cost. Default: Cost. May be none.

decisions.description: The ticket field that holds Decisions. Default: none, the description. Spec and acceptance-criteria may name the same field.

spec.description: The ticket field that holds Spec. Default: none, the description. Spec and acceptance-criteria may name the same field.

acceptance-criteria.description: The ticket field that holds Acceptance criteria. Default: none, the description. Spec and acceptance-criteria may name the same field.

for-the-builder.description: The ticket field that holds For the builder. Default: none, the description. Spec and acceptance-criteria may name the same field.

^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$.description: The ticket field that holds a heading of your own: the heading in lowercase, with hyphens for spaces. May be none.

code-host.description: Where pull requests are, and what a build names its branch. branch-name is required, here or from a preset.

branch-name.description: The pattern a build names its branch by: {ticket}, the ticket's number, which it must have, and {user}, the code host account the build runs as. Quote it, as "{ticket}" or "feature/{user}/{ticket}". No default: factory init asks for it.

code-host.labels.description: Your own names for the labels on pull requests. A key left out keeps its default name.

merge-automatic.description: The merge policy's label on a pull request that merges itself once every check passes. Default: merge-automatic.

merge-manual.description: The merge policy's label on a pull request that waits for a person to merge it. Default: merge-manual.

verdict-override.description: The label a person adds to pass the automated review's verdict for the newest commit. Sessions never add it. Default: verdict-override.

builds.description: What starts a build, and where it runs.

trigger.description: What starts a build for a ticket you moved to Ready. Default: manual.

runner.description: Where an unattended build runs. Default: github-actions.

poll-minutes.description: How often the scheduled poller checks the board, in minutes, with builds.trigger: github-action. Default: 5.

max-per-hour.description: How many builds the poller starts in any one hour. Default: 20.

specs.description: How the written spec for a visible change is kept.

type.description: How the spec for a visible change is kept. Default: none.

check.description: The command that checks the specs, run from the repository's root with DO_NOT_TRACK=1. Needs type: openspec. Default: npx --no-install openspec validate --all --strict --no-interactive.

commands.description: Every command a build runs, each from the repository's root.

build-setup.description: Commands run before an unattended build starts work.

before-commit.description: Commands run before every commit a session makes. If one fails, the commit is blocked.

gate.description: Commands that check a change, run in order before a session reports a task done.

test-one.description: Runs one test alone. $FILE is the test's file and $NAME the test's name, empty for the whole file.

end-to-end.description: Runs one end-to-end spec alone. $FILE is the spec's file.

relock.description: Rebuilds the package manager's lock file after a conflict in it. Default: npm install.

commands.coverage.description: How coverage is measured, and where its report lands.

report.description: The path of the lcov report the command writes.

plugins.description: Your own skills and agents, grouped by the phase they work in. Every role is optional.

builders.description: Skills that build a ticket carrying one of their labels.

reviewers.description: Agents considered when a change touches one of their files.
The whole list of agents that read a change's tests. Default: factory-test-reviewer alone.

plugins.conflicts.description: Plugins for a conflict with the default branch.

resolvers.description: Skills that rebuild their files after a conflict, in place of a merge by hand.

plugins.refine.refiner.description: The skill that refines a ticket, in place of factory-refine.

skill.description: The name of one of your own skills, in .claude/skills/.

plugins.refine.mockups.description: The skill that makes pictures when a decision changes the look.

skill.description: The name of one of your own skills, in .claude/skills/.
The name of one of your own skills, in .claude/skills/.

labels.description: It builds a ticket carrying one of these labels.

off.description: Leaves out the plugin of this name that a preset adds. Only this file can.

agent.description: The name of an agent, in .claude/agents/.

files.description: It is considered when a change touches one of these.

off.description: Leaves out the plugin of this name that a preset adds. Only this file can.

plugins.test.prover.description: The skill that proves a new test can fail, in place of factory-mutate.

skill.description: The name of one of your own skills, in .claude/skills/.

plugins.test.reviewers[].description: One reviewer of a change's tests.

agent.description: The name of an agent, in .claude/agents/.

files.description: It is considered only when a change touches one of these. Left out, it is considered whenever a change touches tests.

off.description: Leaves out the plugin of this name that a preset adds. Only this file can.

skill.description: The name of one of your own skills, in .claude/skills/.

files.description: It resolves a conflict in one of these.

off.description: Leaves out the plugin of this name that a preset adds. Only this file can.

auto-merge.description: Which pull requests may merge without you.

allow.description: Patterns for files safe to merge unread.

deny.description: Exceptions inside allow. deny always wins.

commands.description: Your own checks. Each is run once for a pull request and can veto it.

pr-review.description: The automated review of every pull request: on when this is written, even with nothing under it.

commands.description: Commands the review may run, as prefixes, beside the factory's own, such as your tests.

site.description: How the factory looks at your website.

start.description: Builds and serves the site from the repository's root; $PORT is set.

design-guide.description: A file of your own design rules.

pages.description: The paths to look at. Otherwise from /sitemap.xml, or the home page's links.

widths.description: The widths, in pixels, each page is shot at. Default: [390, 1280].

hide.description: CSS selectors hidden before every picture, for something that floats.

checks.description: Your own measuring commands. Each gets one JSON object on its standard input.

max-pages.description: How many changed pages the agent reads closely. Default: 4.

start-minutes.description: How long to wait for the site to answer after start is run. Default: 5.

accessibility.description: The WCAG level axe-core measures each changed page against; none runs no accessibility rules. Default: wcag22aa.

new-values.description: Whether a font size, color, spacing, or corner radius the change brings in that the base site uses nowhere is reported. Default: true.

session-minutes.description: How long each kind of unattended session may run, in minutes. The job around it gets 10 more. GitHub's own runners stop a job at 6 hours, so a value above 350 does nothing there.

build.description: A build of a ticket. Default: 230.

conflicts.description: A fix of a pull request's conflicts with the default branch. Default: 110.

review.description: An answer to your review of a pull request. Default: 50.

dependencies.description: Work on the dependency pull requests. Default: 50.

rules.description: Numbers the process rules use, for a repository that wants different ones.

small-change-lines.description: A change under this many lines outside tests, specs, and content, adding no component and no state, takes the lighter path. Default: 30.

review-rounds.description: Rounds a session works a review before it hands what is left to you. Default: 2.
